description: Tool-name probe for the managed-MCP experiment. A PreToolUse hook emits a systemMessage (renders as a visible hook code block) with the EXACT tool name whenever report_issue is invoked, so the managed-server form (mcp__<server>__report_issue) can be compared against the plugin-bundled form (mcp__plugin_<plugin>_<server>__report_issue). Single `python` command -- no shell polyglot, so no foreign-shell 'command not found' noise. Emits ONLY systemMessage (no additionalContext): an instruction-shaped additionalContext on a PreToolUse gets the tool BLOCKED by the auto-mode classifier. This plugin bundles NO MCP server -- error-reporting is supplied via bootstrap managedMcpServers.
